div.style: color: rgb(22, 37, 52) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
API → graph.invoke(initial_state, config)
State 初始字段：user_id · request_id · message · daily_transfer_total?
config：thread_id

div.style: color: rgb(22, 37, 52) !important; display: table; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
color: rgb(22, 37, 52) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
load_context
IN(State) user_id · request_id · daily_transfer_total?
OUT(always) status · result · response · authorized · plan · plan_valid
operation_hash · challenge_id · context_valid
OUT(valid context) account_id · balance · daily_transfer_total

div.style: color: rgb(22, 37, 52) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
color: rgb(22, 37, 52) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
understand_intent
IN(State) message
OUT(ΔState) intent · recipient_name · amount · missing_fields

div.style: color: rgb(22, 37, 52) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
resolve_entities
IN(State) intent · recipient_name · missing_fields
OUT(ΔState) contact_id · missing_fields
非 TRANSFER 时返回空更新 {}

div.style: color: rgb(22, 37, 52) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
ask_clarification
IN(State) missing_fields
OUT(ΔState) status · response

div.style: color: rgb(22, 37, 52) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
create_plan
IN(State) intent · contact_id · amount
OUT(ΔState) plan

div.style: color: rgb(22, 37, 52) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
color: rgb(22, 37, 52) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
color: rgb(22, 37, 52) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
color: rgb(22, 37, 52) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
security_policy
IN(always) plan
IN(TRANSFER) daily_transfer_total
IN(non-denied TRANSFER) user_id · account_id · contact_id · request_id
OUT(always) risk_level
OUT(non-denied TRANSFER) operation_hash · challenge_id

div.style: color: rgb(22, 37, 52) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
color: rgb(22, 37, 52) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
execute_query
IN(State) balance
OUT(ΔState) status · result

div.style: color: rgb(22, 37, 52) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
interrupt_for_confirmation
IN(State) challenge_id · operation_hash · recipient_name · amount
INTERRUPT payload kind · challenge_id · operation_hash · recipient · amount
RESUME payload approved · challenge_id · operation_hash
OUT(ΔState) authorized

div.style: color: rgb(22, 37, 52) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
interrupt_for_authentication
IN(State) challenge_id · operation_hash · amount
INTERRUPT payload kind · challenge_id · operation_hash · methods · amount
RESUME payload challenge_id · operation_hash · auth_token
OUT(ΔState) authorized

div.style: color: rgb(22, 37, 52) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
color: rgb(22, 37, 52) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
color: rgb(22, 37, 52) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
execute_operation
IN(always) authorized
IN(authorized) amount · balance
IN(success) recipient_name
OUT(ΔState) status · result

div.style: color: rgb(22, 37, 52) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
color: rgb(22, 37, 52) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
compose_response
IN(State) status · result
OUT(ΔState) response

div.style: color: rgb(22, 37, 52) !important; display: table; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
color: rgb(22, 37, 52) !important; display: table; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
color: rgb(22, 37, 52) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Checkpoint / InMemorySaver
保存：当前 State + 执行位置
定位：config.configurable.thread_id
恢复：同一 thread_id + Command(resume=...)

div.style: color: rgb(22, 37, 52) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
图例
IN / READ：函数直接读取的 State 字段
OUT(ΔState)：节点返回并合并进 State 的字段
未列字段只被 Checkpoint 保留，不代表节点读取

div.style: color: rgb(22, 37, 52) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
澄清路径说明
ask_clarification → END 不是 interrupt
下一条用户消息会用同一 thread_id 发起新一轮 graph.invoke

div.style: color: rgb(22, 37, 52) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
thread_id 安全边界
必须绑定当前登录用户，并在每轮重新注入可信 user_id / request_id
禁止跨用户复用；否则旧 Checkpoint 字段可能在 State 合并时被保留
